title: LOXL4, CREB5 and steroid hormone biosynthesis pathways are involved in type 1 diabetes with polycystic ovary-like changes.
authors: Liang, Zefeng; Zhang, Qiongyin; Liu, Yuzhen; Liu, Zi; Jiang, Yuxi; Yang, Xuesong; Wei, Lina; Wang, Guang
journal: European journal of obstetrics, gynecology, and reproductive biology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过RNA-seq和机器学习分析T1DM多囊卵巢小鼠模型，聚焦卵巢病理与激素通路，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus (T1DM) is related to increased Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) prevalence in women. However, the molecular mechanisms have not been fully elucidated. METHODS: A meta-analysis was conducted to estimate the prevalence of PCOS in women with T1DM. Then a mouse model of T1DM with polycystic ovaries was established using streptozotocin (STZ). RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was performed on ovaries to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and enriched pathways. Machine learning algorithms (LASSO, Random Forest, and SVM-RFE) were applied to pinpoint key genes linking T1DM and polycystic ovary-like changes. RESULTS: Meta-analysis revealed a 25 % PCOS prevalence in T1DM (95 % CI: 0.19-0.32). T1DM mice exhibited reduced ovarian weight and size, decreased serum estradiol levels, and an increased number of antral follicles compared to controls. RNA-seq analysis revealed a significant enrichment of DEGs in the steroid hormone biosynthesis pathway, involving Cyp19a1 and Cyp17a1. Machine learning analysis highlighted LOXL4 and CREB5 as potential key mediators, with receiver operating characteristic (ROC) area under the curve (AUC) values of 0.724 and 0.771, respectively. CONCLUSIONS: This study highlights a key role for steroid hormone biosynthesis in T1DM-associated polycystic ovary-like changes through the identification of enriched DEGs. The identification of LOXL4 and CREB5 as novel mediators offers new insights into the molecular pathogenesis of T1DM-associated polycystic ovary-like changes.
abstract_zh: 背景：1型糖尿病（T1DM）与女性多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）患病率增加相关。然而，其分子机制尚未完全阐明。方法：进行了一项荟萃分析以评估T1DM女性中PCOS的患病率。随后，使用链脲佐菌素（STZ）建立了伴有卵巢多囊样改变的T1DM小鼠模型。对卵巢进行了RNA测序（RNA-seq），以鉴定差异表达基因（DEGs）及富集通路。应用机器学习算法（LASSO、随机森林和SVM-RFE）来精确定位连接T1DM与卵巢多囊样改变的关键基因。结果：荟萃分析显示，T1DM中PCOS患病率为25%（95% CI：0.19-0.32）。与对照组相比，T1DM小鼠表现出卵巢重量和大小减少、血清雌二醇水平降低以及窦卵泡数量增加。RNA-seq分析显示，DEGs在类固醇激素生物合成通路中显著富集，涉及Cyp19a1和Cyp17a1。机器学习分析突出LOXL4和CREB5为潜在关键介质，其受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线下面积（AUC）值分别为0.724和0.771。结论：本研究通过富集DEGs的鉴定，强调了类固醇激素生物合成在T1DM相关卵巢多囊样改变中的关键作用。LOXL4和CREB5作为新型介质的识别，为T1DM相关卵巢多囊样改变的分子发病机制提供了新见解。
